articles.summary: Indian equities extended their recovery on Thursday, with the Nifty 50 advancing 238 points, or 1.05%, to close above the 22,900 mark. Stocks expected to remain in focus include Reliance Industries, Jio Platforms, IndiGo, Trent, Suzlon Energy, Vedanta Power, and RVNL.

articles.title: Flood-Damaged Pfizer Plant in India Will Not Reopen Until 2028, Prolonging Shortages of Several Chemotherapy Drugs
articles.summary: A Pfizer manufacturing plant in Gujarat, India, will remain closed until 2028 after sustaining damage from flooding. The facility supplied generic chemotherapy drugs to the U.S., and its prolonged closure is expected to extend medication shortages. These shortages are complicating cancer treatment planning according to the American Society of Health-System Pharmacists.
articles.description: A Pfizer plant in Gujarat damaged by flooding will reportedly remain closed until 2028, prolonging U.S. shortages of generic chemotherapy drugs and complicating cancer treatment planning.
